info.title: MediKiosk Core API
info.description:
Patient intake, consent, pre-check-in, QR validation and HIS token requests.

Operations carry `x-status`. `not-implemented` means the contract is fixed but the endpoint is not built yet — it is listed so the intended surface is visible, not to imply it works. The hospital HIS remains the sole authority for a final patient token.

get.summary: Languages, departments, AYUSH systems, feature flags and content versions.

parameters.description: UUID correlating one patient journey across every service.

parameters.description: Kiosk device code, e.g. `MK-OPD-03`. Identification, not authentication — Phase 15 adds mutual-TLS device certificates.
